objective: retain raw linear signal with a leakage-safe nonlinear residual correction

roster.targets: exact ordered targets from the parent frozen n300 protocol
roster.backbones: exact scout roster from the parent frozen n300 protocol

outer_split.row_identity: parent frozen relative n300 row order plus sample ID

inner_residual_protocol.base_model: raw outer-training PCA plus train-only Ridge alpha CV
inner_residual_protocol.geometry_fit_rows: outer-training rows with OOF residual targets only
inner_residual_protocol.shrinkage_selection: one deterministic 80/20 split of outer-training OOF residuals; fit geometry/readout on 80% and score y on disjoint 20%
inner_residual_protocol.selection_metric: heldout R2 of base_oof + shrinkage * residual correction
inner_residual_protocol.tie_break: smallest shrinkage, so zero is an explicit no-harm option

geometry.save_and_rff: parent frozen SAVE and RFF-mean blocks
geometry.prototype_space: equal-weight SAVE+RFF fit once per residual outer fold

controls.conditional_association: permute fitted residual feature rows while keeping base holdout and correction targets fixed
controls.target_permutation_geometry: permute outer-training residual targets before fitting residual geometry, then read out against true residuals

truth: parent validated n300 heldout four-head envelope R2; source-selected and not an independent target draw
source_hashes: recorded in this protocol before outcomes
